broker_credit_agricole.description: Import from Crédit Agricole exports (CSV or XLSX): the 'Lista Movimenti Deposito Titoli' securities movements (coupons, purchases, redemptions, maturities, succession transfers; balanced with automatic cash counter-entries) and the 'Lista Movimenti Conto' account movements (liquidity, fees, taxes and income as deposits/withdrawals). Assets are identified by name only (no ISIN).
broker_credit_agricole.name: Crédit Agricole
